title: Malformed integer settings can leave the configuration parser spinning

impact.description: Retained source report; practical reachability, actual outcome and port applicability require independent review.

notes: Lead supplied by borg-rs, not independently reproduced by Mandos. A function-context link is not proof of the reported defect. Related sub-symptoms remain grouped pending triage.

references.description: C function context; reported fault site not yet independently checked
reported C observation; not an independent validation

reference.description: reported C observation; not an independent validation

reported_sources.text:
`borg_proc_setting()`: for an int setting, a byte after the name that is
  not ` `, `=`, `-` or a digit (e.g. `borg_stop_dlevel = x`, or an unknown
  key that starts with an int setting's name, `borg_stop_dlevelx 5`) is
  never consumed: the loop spins forever and the game hangs at start-up
  (seen with the C parser at -O2).

next_at_import: Check current C and both ports, duplicate-search the exact symptom, then reproduce a legal scenario with controls before a local proposal. No C submission.
